(2) The amount payable by way of financial disincentive under these regulations shall be remitted to such head of account as may be specified by the Authority. (3) The Authority may impose no financial disincentive or a lower amount of financial disincentive than the amount payable as per the provisions of this regulation, or review the financial disincentives, where it finds merit in the reasons furnished by the Access Provider. 28A. Maximum amount of financial disincentives. - The total amount payable as financial disincentives under regulation 27 and regulation 28 together shall not exceed fifty lakhs
